TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd brings PITB a delivery profile that aligns directly with an enterprise, multi-site network and data-centre rollout: proven large-ticket network design execution, certified management systems, and a governed delivery model suitable for public-sector oversight.

First, our track record meets and exceeds PITB’s “two projects ≥ PKR 30M” threshold with multiple enterprise network design deployments, including PKR 44M (completed 2025), PKR 182M (completed 2022), and PKR 133M (completed 2020) engagements [CAP-021][CAP-009][CAP-033]. This experience is complemented by complex infrastructure deployments in regulated environments, including a federal government hospital IT implementation [CAP-042].

Second, we reduce risk through audited, standardised processes and security governance. We hold ISO 27001 and ISO 9001 certifications [CO-PROFILE], and we have delivered projects evidenced under ISO 27001 and ISO 9001 contexts [CAP-033][CAP-030]. Our delivery organisation also includes PMP-certified project managers (6) [CO-PROFILE], supporting disciplined planning, change control, and knowledge transfer.

Third, we are structurally set up for deployment and support across PITB’s regional footprint. We are SECP incorporated, FBR registered with Active Taxpayer (ATL) status, and Punjab & Sindh sales tax registered [CO-PROFILE]. We maintain offices in Islamabad (HQ), Lahore, and Karachi [CO-PROFILE], and operate an in-country support desk with 24–48h response SLAs [CO-PROFILE].

On the single-OEM/authorisation mandatory requirement, our library does not yet evidence an OEM partner/reseller authorisation for the proposed active equipment; we will close this via OEM-backed partnering and provide the required authorisation letters at bid stage.
